name: receipts
description: Says UNVERIFIED under any answer that claims done with nothing run after the last edit. A band above the prompt shows the steps and an estimate that names its basis; tool rows stay quiet.

spike.title: Spike unfamiliar tasks
spike.description: When a task shape has fewer than 3 past samples and the plan has 3 or more steps, spawn one cheap subagent per task to guess minutes per step. Counts as half a sample.

cleanView.title: Tool rows quiet on start
cleanView.description: Start each session at the quiet rows level: tool rows hidden, milestones one dim line, the turn's chrome folded. Off starts with every row drawn in full. The band's settings change it for the session.
